name: bank

candidate_ids.1: bank via existing static nearest altar field
candidate_ids.2: bank via existing threat-avoiding altar field

semantics: Candidate 0 is the computed teacher verdict and route. Force/winning/deadline bank priorities cannot be vetoed. Route alternatives require already-computed reachable fields. No new distance fields are built. One decision per champion/round; no multi-turn commitment.
legality: Deterministic gems/reachability guards occur before the hook. Continue is excluded when force, wins or late. Every generated candidate is legal; teacher candidate is always retained.
